## src/planet/collisions/chunks.ts

[Source](chunks.ts)

Group nearby GLB triangles into chunks.
Each triangle belongs to one chunk only. The chunk bounds include the whole triangle.
Buildings stay in their own grid so the ground set can load without them.

## Module dependencies

- `../contract.js`

## src/planet/collisions/index.ts

[Source](index.ts)

Planet collision from GLB triangles.

`chunks` bins triangles into a 32 m grid. `collisions` turns the nearby bins
into static trimeshes.
